title: Sharks and whales
examples: How do whales breathe if they live in the water?
What is the biggest animal in the ocean?

explain.say: Sharks and whales can look alike in the water. But they are very different animals.
Sharks are fish. Fish breathe with gills. Whales breathe air with lungs, like you.
Whales are mammals. Mammals are warm-blooded, and their babies drink milk.
The blue whale is the largest animal on Earth. It is a mammal.
A dolphin lives in the ocean too. It breathes air through a blowhole.
A common mistake is to think all sea animals breathe with gills. Whales use lungs.

draw.text: Mistake: thinking all sea animals use gills

faq.a: Yes, sharks are classified as fish. They breathe using gills to extract oxygen from the water.

faq.q: Do whales ever come onto land?
faq.a: No. Whales live in the water all their lives. They come up to the surface to breathe.
asks: Do whales live only in the sea?

faq.q: What makes a mammal different from a fish?
faq.a: Mammals are warm-blooded, they breathe air with lungs, and they feed their young milk.
asks: What do mammals have that fish do not?
How do we know if an animal is a mammal?

faq.q: How big is the blue whale?
faq.a: The blue whale is enormous. It is the largest animal known to have ever lived on Earth.
asks: Is the blue whale the biggest animal?

faq.a: Most sharks eat fish, squid and other sea animals. Big whales are far too large for most sharks.

facts: Sharks belong to the group of fish.
Whales are mammals, meaning they breathe air.
The blue whale is the largest animal on Earth.
Mammals nurse their young with milk.

quiz.say: Which sea animal breathes with gills?
quiz.why: Sharks are fish. Fish breathe with gills.

wrong.1: A whale is a mammal, so it breathes air with lungs.
wrong.2: A dolphin is a mammal, so it breathes air through a blowhole.

quiz.say: Which is true of all mammals?
quiz.why: Mammal mothers feed their babies milk. Whale calves drink milk too.

wrong.0: Fish breathe with gills, and mammals breathe air with lungs.

quiz.say: An animal breathes air through a blowhole. What is it?
quiz.why: Whales and dolphins breathe air through a blowhole on top of their head.
